dog.description_text:
My foster writes: Chance is a superstar in the making and I believe he'll end up being someone's Soul Dog. He's still learning the ways of the world but he's being an absolute charmer & sweetheart while he figures it out.

He's incredibly mature around people and finds comfort in hugs & petting, he can even be brought with you into stores or visiting other people's homes because he's so relaxed. He has a high-energy puppy streak when it comes to toys or playing in the garden but even then he showed control when he was jumping up from his Zoomies!

On his short break with my he mastered the skill of getting cozy on the couch either by himself or getting touch tight in the evenings! He would also take himself off to his bed by himself and slept in his own bed all night. He had excellent potty training and had zero accidents even though he was in numerous new environments.

He was the ideal house guest since he is so instantly lovable and I cannot wait for him to visit again; although of course, the real hope is that he finds that special person to give him a real opportunity to be the best boy he is in a full time home and bond with someone forever.
dog.name: Chance
